name: Sotozuma
source:
Main character is a city hall official. He has a wife and a child, but life is getting more and more stressful lately. One day a big breasted housewife from the same apartment comes to get his consultation on health insurance. His stress fires desire, so he invites her to the isolated room and starts to live double life weaving a net of lies.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-july-2007-bullet-butlers.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是市政厅官员。他有妻子和孩子，但最近生活压力越来越大。有一天，来自同一公寓的一位大胸主妇来咨询他的健康保险问题。他的压力激发了欲望，于是他邀请她来到隔离的房间，开始过着编织谎言之网的双重生活。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-july-2007-bullet-butlers.html]vndbreview[/url]]
